name: std::weak_ptr<T>::expired
intro: Equivalent to use_count() == 0. The destructor for the managed object may not yet have been called, but this object's destruction is imminent (or may have already happened).

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the managed object has already been deleted, false otherwise.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: If the managed object is shared among threads, it is only meaningful when expired() returns true.

examples.output:
gw is valid
gw is expired
